title: The First Flat
setting: 6pm. HSR Layout. A four-storey building the colour of an old envelope. Rangaswamy is already in the parking lot, pacing, on a different call. He waves you over without breaking off.

beats.native: ಸಾರ್! ಬನ್ನಿ ಬನ್ನಿ. ಮಾಲೀಕ out of town ಇದ್ದಾರೆ — ನಾನು key ಇಟ್ಟಿದ್ದೇನೆ.
beats.translit: sār! banni banni. mālīka out of town iddāre — nānu key iṭṭiddēne.
beats.en: Sir! Come come. The owner's out of town — I have the keys.
beats.beat: key chain spinning on one finger, phone wedged between ear and shoulder

beats.native: Fully furnished ಸಾರ್. Geyser, fridge, washing machine, ಎಲ್ಲಾ ready. ಬನ್ನಿ ಮೇಲೆ.
beats.translit: fully furnished sār. geyser, fridge, washing machine, ellā ready. banni mēle.
beats.en: Fully furnished, sir. Geyser, fridge, washing machine — everything ready. Come on up.
beats.beat: taking the stairs two at a time

beats.native: ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಬಚ್ಚಲು, ಇಲ್ಲಿ kitchen. Geyser ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ problem ಇದೆ but ನಾಳೆ fix.
beats.translit: illi baccalu, illi kitchen. geyser svalpa problem ide but nāḷe fix.
beats.en: Bathroom here, kitchen here. Geyser has a small problem — but tomorrow fix.
beats.beat: the geyser is unplugged. the tap is dripping. the wall has a damp patch.

beats.prompt: You take a slow look around. You say:

choices.native: Geyser, tap, ಒಂದು ಗೋಡೆ — ತುಂಬಾ problems ಸಾರ್. ಮಾಲೀಕ ಯಾವಾಗ ಬರ್ತಾರೆ?
choices.translit: geyser, tap, ondu gōḍe — tumbā problems sār. mālīka yāvāga bartāre?
choices.en: Geyser, tap, one wall — too many problems, sir. When's the owner back?
I'd like to meet the owner first before deciding.

beats.native: ಸಾರ್, owner ತುಂಬಾ busy. ಎಲ್ಲಾ small problems ಸಾರ್, ನಾಳೆ fix ಮಾಡ್ತೀವಿ. ನೀವು ಮೊದಲು yes ಹೇಳಿ.
beats.translit: sār, owner tumbā busy. ellā small problems sār, nāḷe fix māḍtīvi. nīvu modalu yes hēḷi.
beats.en: Sir, the owner is very busy. All small problems, we'll fix tomorrow. You just say yes first.
beats.beat: his Bluetooth lights up — another caller waiting

choices.native: ಇಲ್ಲ ಸಾರ್. ಇದು ಬೇಡ. ಬೇರೆ ಒಂದು flat ತೋರಿಸಿ.
choices.translit: illa sār. idu bēḍa. bēre ondu flat tōrisi.
choices.en: No sir. Not this one. Show me a different flat.
I'll think and let you know tomorrow.
Okay, how much is the deposit?

beats.native: Hmm. ಸರಿ ಸಾರ್. ನಾಳೆ ಬೇರೆ ಒಂದು ತೋರಿಸ್ತೀನಿ. Indiranagar ನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಇದೆ — Krishnamurthy uncle ಮಾಲೀಕ. ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಚಿಕ್ಕ but clean.
beats.translit: hmm. sari sār. nāḷe bēre ondu tōristīni. Indiranagar-nalli ondu ide — Krishnamurthy uncle mālīka. svalpa cikka but clean.
beats.en: Hmm. Okay sir. Tomorrow I'll show another. There's one in Indiranagar — Krishnamurthy uncle is the owner. A bit smaller, but clean.
beats.beat: the hustle softens — he's reading the room now
